boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission, no-purchase ways for Saint Anselm students to connect on campus, with eligibility and seasonal details noted.

cards.title: Play carnival games at PYCO
cards.subtitle: Campus Activities Board tradition
cards.notes: Watch Campus Activities Board announcements, then bring friends for the carnival games and inflatables; the college lists free food and swag too.
cards.short_summary: A school-run social event with games and inflatables.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm identifies PYCO as a Campus Activities Board event featuring free food, free swag, carnival games, and giant inflatables.
cards.access_notes: College tradition; check campus announcements for timing and location.

cards.title: Join a Campus Dinner Discussion
cards.subtitle: Center for Ethics in Society
cards.notes: Email the Center for Ethics about the next discussion, then come ready to talk through a big idea with students, professors, staff, and monks.
cards.short_summary: A facilitated conversation series for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Ethics says students eat a free catered dinner while discussing topics with professors, staff, and monks.
cards.source_title: Programs for Saint Anselm Students | Center for Ethics in Society
cards.access_notes: For the Saint Anselm College community; contact ethics@anselm.edu for upcoming discussions.

cards.title: Talk ideas at Come Friday
cards.subtitle: Humanities Institute common-hour discussion
cards.notes: Meet during common hour for the open informal discussion led by a college faculty, staff, or monastic-community member; bring a question to the table.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, open common-hour humanities conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm describes Come Friday as an open, informal common-hour discussion and states that it is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited college listing describes the series as held Fridays during common hour, 12:30–1:20 p.m.; verify the current session before attending.

cards.title: Meet peers through Transitions
cards.subtitle: Fr. Jonathan, O.S.B. Center for Intercultural Learning and Inclusion
cards.notes: Eligible new students can register for the pre-orientation program to meet peer leaders, explore campus resources, and take part in workshops and social events.
cards.short_summary: A three-day, no-cost pre-orientation connection program.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm says the Transitions Program includes a free three-day pre-orientation experience, workshops, social events, and peer mentoring.
cards.access_notes: For new students; the page lists the 2026 program for August 24–26 and directs students to the New Student Page to register.

cards.title: Drop into Commuter Appreciation Week
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center; commuter programming
cards.notes: If you commute, look for the once-per-semester appreciation week and use it as a low-key way to meet other commuters between classes.
cards.short_summary: A recurring recognition week for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists Commuter Appreciation Week among its annual commuter events and states that all listed events are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; held once each semester at the Intercultural Center.

cards.title: Start term at Welcome Back Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center; commuter programming
cards.notes: Commuter students can watch for the September or January breakfast, then arrive early enough to connect with other commuters before the day begins.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists Welcome Back Breakfast in September and January as annual commuter events and states that all listed events are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; held in the Intercultural Center.

cards.title: Connect at Joe ’n Go
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center; November commuter event
cards.notes: Commuter students can check the fall schedule for Joe ’n Go, then use the Intercultural Center stop as a brief chance to connect on campus.
cards.short_summary: A November event in the commuter-programming calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists Joe ’n Go in November among annual commuter events and states that all listed events are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; held in the Intercultural Center. Confirm the annual date with the Center.

cards.title: Visit the Hot Cocoa Bar
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center; December commuter event
cards.notes: Commuter students can look for this December gathering at the Intercultural Center and use the break to catch up with peers on campus.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal December option for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists a Hot Cocoa Bar in December among annual commuter events and states that all listed events are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; held in the Intercultural Center. Confirm the annual date with the Center.

cards.title: Gather at Free Commuter Lunch
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center; February commuter event
cards.notes: Commuter students can put the February lunch on their calendar and invite a classmate for a relaxed on-campus connection between classes.
cards.short_summary: A February lunch included in the commuter event calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists Free Commuter Lunch in February among annual commuter events and states that all listed events are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; held in the Intercultural Center. Confirm the annual date with the Center.

cards.title: Pause for Coffee and Pastries
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center; March commuter event
cards.notes: Commuter students can check for the March gathering, then stop in at the Intercultural Center to meet people before heading to class.
cards.short_summary: A March social stop for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Anselm lists Coffee and Pastries in March among annual commuter events and states that all listed events are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; held in the Intercultural Center. Confirm the annual date with the Center.
